{{Top|leg}}
'''Carilla's Catering and Wedding Planning''' was a wedding-planning shop located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], which was operated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Carilla]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;traveled to Carilla's shop while investigating a plot to disrupt the wedding of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]].
